audit.whatIsWrong: Content level chart (Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Skill, Skill, Gragas, Gragas) disagrees with the packet chart (Skill, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Sylas, Sylas), and the whys[] prose is shifted one row out of alignment with its own labels from index 2 onward.
audit.why: whys[2] sits in the Level 3 slot but describes 'the level 4-5 window'; whys[3] sits in Levels 4-5 but describes 'your level 6 spike'; whys[4] sits in Level 6 but describes 'the first-item trade'; whys[5] sits in First item but describes 'by two items'. Every row after Level 2 is telling the player about the wrong stage. The packet chart is internally consistent with the real story: Gragas owns 3 through 6, Sylas takes over once AP scaling and Hijack are on items.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Sylas, Sylas across both layers, and whys[1..5] rewritten so each row describes its own label.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer treats First item and 2+ items as Gragas-favoured phases while the content layer's own late-game prose says Sylas out-scales and Hijacks the cask.
audit.why: Both layers must tell the same spike story. Sylas's Hijack drops to 55s at rank 2 and 30s at rank 3, so the stolen Explosive Cask is available almost every fight once he has levels and AP — that is the spike that ends Gragas's window.
audit.corrected: phases[5] and phases[6] flipped to Sylas with matching whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: Abscond / Abduct is described as 'a dash AND a chain-pull stun on two charges' (early) and 'His dash + stun (recast pull)' (breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t), and wants.foe[1] says 'his two E dashes'.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.' It is one cast with a recast, not two charges, the recast pulls SYLAS to the target rather than the target to him, and nothing in the text grants a stun. Range is 400, cooldown 13/12/11/10/9. The second mobility tool the page is missing entirely is Kingslayer (W) — a 400-range lunge on 12/10.5/9/7.5/6 that also heals him.
audit.corrected: Abscond is a 400-range dash, 13s at rank 1 down to 9s; the recast chain-pulls Sylas onto a target he hits. His second movement is Kingslayer, not a second E charge. No stun in this kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan'.
audit.why: Gragas Body Slam is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 — 14s at rank 1, which is exactly when a player whiffs it.
Common mistakes are stage-based, not elo-split, and the headline error (body-slamming into a live Abscond) is the right one.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are a coin-flip AP brawl. Don't throw a raw Barrel Roll he can sidestep — drink W first, step in with the empowered auto, then detonate a fermented Q on top of him. Respect his E above all: Abscond/Abduct is a dash AND a chain-pull stun on two charges, so he can engage or escape your Body Slam, and if you whiff your own E you have zero CC left to answer his.
